## Problem statement

A company that builds downhole tools has to order some parts long before it needs them. Machined housings and specialty alloys can take months to arrive. How many tools customers want depends on how much drilling is going on, so a buyer planning those orders wants to know: **how many rigs will be running six months from now, and how sure can we be?**
::::
:::::

::::: {.cs-sec}
:::: {.num}
03
::::
:::: {}
## Approach

::: {.pending data-tag="Planned"}
Planned steps:

1. Pull the weekly US rig count and roll it up to monthly
2. Plot the trend and look for seasonal patterns with ggplot2
3. Fit and compare ETS and ARIMA models with the fable package
4. Test accuracy on a held-back year of data
5. Turn the forecast range into an ordering rule for long-lead parts

The R code, with comments, goes here. Each step becomes a short section with its code chunk and one line on why.
:::
